clauses.reason: Record the frozen release-closure rule before treating the implementation as qualified.

updates.rationale: Parser, schema, command text, and the installed entry were accepted separately, so later stages kept reopening the same release. One format-5 closure freezes those boundaries without another consumer migration.
scope: Installed Skill update and entry switch
updates.statement: Manifest format stays 5. Omitted evidence fields mean the published evidence protocol and schema digest, and an explicit digest must equal that schema. Bare update installs the newest eligible stable release and prepares that candidate; --check and --to stay optional, and an already-current or older release does not replace the installation. Version directories stay immutable. An upgrade switches only the install entry, refuses Git-managed source and version-storage rewrites, and does not take the use lock of a version directory already resolved by a running command. The updater never edits the project. Skill content identity and engine implementation identity stay separate and share one labeled digest function.

decisions.reason: The owner froze one format-5 release closure: bare update installs the latest stable Skill, and the install entry switches without rewriting version directories or source checkouts.

boundaries: One manifest format and one published evidence schema digest.
Version directories stay immutable and outside the project.
revision.summary: Format 5 bindings and an install entry that switches independently of version storage.

transaction.reason: Apply the approved format-5 install-entry decision before implementation commits.
